# Open Source AI Independence

> Community initiative for independent, decentralized where appropriate, transparent, interoperable, reliable, and human-centered AI infrastructure.

## Context
This is an early mission and coordination repository, not a mature software product. Planned work is not implemented merely because it appears in docs. No zero-hallucination, absolute-security, or universal-decentralization guarantee is made.
